meta.title: Who Is Actually Paying for the AI Boom?

overlays.text: NVIDIA intends to invest up to $100 billion, progressively as each gigawatt is deployed.
The prepaid and customer supplied hardware portions of our large AI contracts now total $75 billion.
Now you know which numbers to watch.

style._: word-pop (heavy sans, thick stroke, no pill) outperformed the pill and broadcast presets across all three reference teardowns. 1-2 words per card; cards break on sentence end, long pause, and speaker change (F5).
